note: Population: Census Bureau resident population via FRED (<ST>POP), thousands, one value a year (July 1 estimates; decennial years bridge the census count). Components: Census Bureau NST-EST2025-ALLDATA.csv; each year runs July 1 to June 30 and is revised with every vintage. Components need not sum to the change in the estimate (a small residual remains). Do not edit: rerun tools/make_states.py with the new vintage instead.

flows.note: American Community Survey 2024 1-year state-to-state migration flows: people 1 year and over living in a state at the survey who lived in another a year earlier. Rows are [partner, moved in from it, margin, moved out to it, margin]; margins are 90%; null where the Census Bureau suppresses the cell (too few sample cases). gain and loss: the two largest nets either way whose net clears the margin of the difference, sqrt(m1^2 + m2^2), largest first (so the tool can say when the top two are too close to call).

col.note: BEA regional price parities and personal income by state, 2024, as published February 19, 2026 (ALFRED vintage 2026-02-21). Rows are [price level, U.S. = 100; personal income per person, dollars; BEA real personal income per person restated in 2024 dollars with the national PCE price index, i.e. income at U.S.-average prices; 1 if that figure is BEA real personal income over population because FRED lacks the per-person series]. Income per person is ALFRED vintage 2026-04-15, the state income figures the real estimates were built on (the Feb 2026 vintage still held the March 2025 preliminary figures). us_pcpi: BEA real per capita personal income for the U.S. (RPIPCUS) restated the same way; at U.S. prices it is also the U.S. income.
